title: Agnostic learning of circuit classes under randomized average-case easiness of NP

standard_prerequisites.name: Imported RRHS-refutation-to-agnostic-learning theorem [21], unconditional pKt coding theorem [34], classical Kolmogorov entropy bound [27] and DPG reconstruction [11]
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact imported statements retained. All source-local pKt reconstruction/symmetry/approximation, sampling-depth, entropy encoding, refuter and final application proofs included. Imported theorems are not recursively reproved.

core_obligations: Approximate probabilistic time-bounded Kolmogorov complexity under the exact randomized average-case easiness assumption.
Bound probabilistic sampling depth of samplable distributions through coding and entropy.
Construct a correlative RRHS refuter using the difference between labelled and unlabelled sample complexities.
Prove refuter soundness by low-Hamming-weight entropy encoding and completeness by symmetry/incompressibility, then apply the imported learning reduction.
difficulty_reason: Non-routine probabilistic-complexity approximation and sampling-depth arguments separate correlated labels from random labels. An explicit entropy encoding of label errors and symmetry/incompressibility analysis yield a refuter, then agnostic learning with the author sample/time bounds. All support statements are bundled as one main result.
